First, note the offsets:  
Asia/Kolkata = UTC+5:30, US/Hawaii = UTC-10.  

Target time = source_time + (target_offset − source_offset)  
= 10:00 + (−10 − 5:30)  
= 10:00 − 15:30  
= −5:30  

Add 24 hours: −5:30 + 24:00 = 18:30 previous day.  

Since it’s March 20 in Kolkata, subtract 1 day for Hawaii → March 19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: March 19, 18:30
